name: INC Ransom (G1032) vs this SIEM - procedure level (Module 08 Lab 05)
description: The 25 techniques ATT&CK cites for INC Ransom, coloured by whether our detections would catch INC's cited procedure. No cell is green: 0 procedures proven. Score = gap priority (1 = build first).
